mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (type, target_type, target_id, user_id) VALUES (#{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.is_read, n.created_at, COALESCE(q1.title, q2.title) AS question_title, COALESCE(q1.question_id, q2.question_id) AS question_id, (COALESCE(q1.deleted_at, q2.deleted_at) IS NOT NULL OR a1.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_deleted, a1.content AS answer_content, c.content AS comment FROM notification n LEFT JOIN answer a1 ON n.type = 'ANSWER_CREATED' AND n.target_id = a1.answer_id LEFT JOIN question q1 ON a1.question_id = q1.question_id LEFT JOIN comment c ON n.type = 'COMMENT_CREATED' AND n.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN answer a2 ON c.answer_id = a2.answer_id LEFT JOIN question q2 ON a2.question_id = q2.question_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY n.is_read ASC, n.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE is_read = false AND user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT q.user_id FROM answer a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.question_id WHERE a.answer_id = #{answerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = true WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = false
